## Problem

What travel-planning need does this address? (e.g. "I can't compare hotel
prices because there's no hotel provider wired up.")

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see added? If it involves a new external API, name
it and note whether it has a free tier.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or examples from other apps are welcome.
